newsitem.title: USA: Flagstar Cos restructuring gets backing.
newsitem.headline: Flagstar Cos restructuring gets backing.

text.p: Flagstar Cos Inc said Tuesday its financial restructuring plan has received "overwhelming approval" from its shareholders and creditors.
The approval paves the way for a voluntary, prepackaged Chapter 11 filing in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in South Carolina within the next few days, it said.

Flagstar, a restaurant chain that operates Denny's, Coco's, El Pollo Loco, Carrows, and Quincy's Family Steakhouse, said the prepackaged filing should result in an expedited bankruptcy process and a quick emergence from Chapter 11.
It said that although one class of creditors holding the smallest amount of Flagstar debt rejected the plan, the court might still approve the plan it it were deemed fair to all stakeholders.
In that event, it said, the debtholder that rejected the plan might forfeit its right to any recovery under the plan.
James Adamson, chairman and chief executive officer, said Flagstar was pleased with the support of other creditors "in the face of much needed financial overhaul."
"With the voting now behind us, we are in an excellent position to complete our restructuring on our original schedule by the fall of this year," he said.
Flagstar operates more than 3,200 restaurants and has annual revenues of about $2.7 billion.
